samples.label: Goods-carrier workbook — all 21 sheets
samples.description: The whole commercial-vehicle workbook as a broker receives it: seventeen per-state goods-carrier grids plus pan-India SATP, 3W non-EV, 3W EV and 4W EV grids. 134 merged regions across 7,351 cells, read end to end.

samples.label: Private car & two-wheeler workbook — 9 sheets
samples.description: Both retail motor lines from a single broker workbook: private-car comprehensive, SAOD, new-business 1+3 and 4W SATP, alongside two-wheeler 1+1, 1+5, 5+5 and SAOD flexi grids — plus the two RTO-to-cluster mapping sheets the rates depend on. 34,572 cells across nine sheets, four and a half times the goods-carrier book.
